data.name: KeyDescription
data.value: Generate RSA and elliptic curve asymmetric key pairs.

data.name: CertDescription
data.value: Generate configurable X.509 certificates, self-signed or issued from a CSR by a CA.

data.name: RsaDescription
data.value: RSA encryption, decryption, signing and verification.

data.name: EcDescription
data.value: Encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify with elliptic curve algorithms and PEM/Base64/Hex public keys.

data.name: SymDescription
data.value: Encrypt and decrypt using 15 block and stream algorithms with compatible modes and padding.

data.name: KeyNote
data.value: Keys are generated locally. Please keep your key pair safe.

data.name: KeyPasswordHint
data.value: Used when generating the private key. Leave empty to generate an unencrypted private key.

data.name: KeyOutputFormatUnavailable
data.value: This output format is unavailable for this key.

data.name: KeyExportNameDescription
data.value: Choose a folder when exporting. The private key uses .key and the public key uses .pub.

data.name: KeyExportUnavailable
data.value: Folder selection is unavailable on this platform.

data.name: KeyExportInvalidName
data.value: Enter a valid file name without a path.

data.name: KeyExportMissingKeys
data.value: Generate both a private key and a public key before exporting.

data.name: KeyExportFileExists
data.value: A .key or .pub file with this name already exists. Choose another name.

data.name: CertNote
data.value: Creates a new key for each operation. Self-signed certificates are for local development; CSR output requires a CA signature.

data.name: KeyPem
data.value: Key (PEM; public key to encrypt/verify, private key to decrypt/sign)

data.name: RsaNote
data.value: Encrypt/sign UTF-8 text; decrypt Base64 ciphertext. RSA accepts short messages only. Signatures are Base64.

data.name: EcNote
data.value: ECDSA uses DER signatures. Ed25519/Ed448 use pure EdDSA. Encryption uses ephemeral ECDH/X25519/X448 + HKDF-SHA256 + AES-256-GCM in a CryptoTools JSON envelope.

data.name: EcKeyNote
data.value: Use a matching key type from the Key generator for the selected operation.

data.name: SymNote
data.value: Encrypt UTF-8 text to a versioned JSON envelope; paste it as input to decrypt. A new random nonce/IV is generated for every encryption. AES/SM4-CBC use PKCS#7 padding and provide no authentication.

data.name: InvalidValidity
data.value: Validity must be an integer from 1 to 3650 days.

data.name: InvalidKey
data.value: The key type does not match the selected algorithm.

data.name: MessageTooLong
data.value: Message exceeds the RSA padding limit. Use hybrid encryption for larger messages.

data.name: InvalidUtf8
data.value: Decrypted data is not valid UTF-8.

data.name: Sm2Id
data.value: SM2 user ID (UTF-8, signing and verification only)

data.name: Sm2Note
data.value: SM2 uses sm2p256v1 and SM3. Encryption output is Base64 raw C1C3C2 or C1C2C3 (uncompressed C1), not a JSON envelope. Signing and verification must use the same user ID.

data.name: InvalidTextEncoding
data.value: These bytes are not valid UTF-8 text. Select Base64 or Hex.

data.name: InvalidPadding
data.value: Padding is not supported for the selected mode.

data.name: InvalidCiphertext
data.value: Ciphertext is shorter than the authentication tag required by the selected mode.

data.name: CbcHint
data.value: CBC uses a 16-byte IV. Without padding, input must be a multiple of 16 bytes. CBC does not authenticate ciphertext.

data.name: AuthenticatedHint
data.value: Uses a 12-byte nonce. The 16-byte authentication tag is appended to the ciphertext.

data.name: InvalidKeyFile
data.value: Unsupported or invalid key/certificate file. Use unencrypted PEM or DER.

data.name: InvalidCoordinates
data.value: Invalid public key coordinates for the selected curve.

data.name: FileTooLarge
data.value: The file exceeds the 1 MiB import limit.

data.name: KeyImportHint
data.value: Drop a PEM/DER key or X.509 certificate below. Certificates automatically provide their public key.

data.name: EcEncryptionDescription
data.value: ECDH/XDH hybrid encryption and SM2 encryption with key/certificate import.

data.name: EcSignatureDescription
data.value: ECDSA, EdDSA and SM2 signatures; verify using keys, certificates or coordinates.

data.name: EcEncryptHint
data.value: Encrypt with a public key or certificate; decrypt with its matching private key. ECDH/XDH output is a JSON envelope.

data.name: EcSignHint
data.value: Sign UTF-8 messages using a private key; verify with a public key or certificate. Signatures are Base64; ECDSA/SM2 use DER.

data.name: CoordinateHint
data.value: Coordinates apply to ECDSA and SM2 verification. Select key/certificate mode to sign.

data.name: InvalidCsr
data.value: Invalid certificate request or CSR signature.

data.name: KeyPairMismatch
data.value: The public key and private key do not match.

data.name: InvalidIssuer
data.value: Invalid issuer certificate or signing key.

data.name: InvalidSerial
data.value: Serial number must be a positive hexadecimal integer of at most 20 bytes.

data.name: UnsupportedSignatureAlgorithm
data.value: Unsupported signature algorithm for this key.

data.name: NoSigningKey
data.value: Generate a signing key pair first.

data.name: CertKeySourceHint
data.value: Leave empty to generate a new key, or import an existing private key / key pair.

data.name: CertIssuerOverride
data.value: Issuer DN (optional; must match signing issuer)

data.name: CertInvalidDate
data.value: Enter a valid UTC date and time, e.g. 2026-11-18 08:00:00Z.

data.name: CertUseIssuer
data.value: Sign with an issuer CA certificate and private key

data.name: CertCsrImportHint
data.value: Import a PEM / DER CSR to load its editable fields. Self-signing needs the matching subject private key; CA issuance needs an issuer certificate and private key.

data.name: CsrDescription
data.value: Generate PKCS#10 certificate requests using new or imported keys.

data.name: CsrBuilderHint
data.value: Generate a PKCS#10 CSR with the selected subject, SANs and extensions. The private key stays local.

data.name: CertGenerateCsrFirst
data.value: Generate a CSR before opening certificate issuance.

data.name: CertCustomExtensionsFormat
data.value: Additional extensions: one OID|true/false|Base64 DER per line

data.name: CertInvalidExtension
data.value: Each custom extension must contain OID|true/false|Base64 DER.

data.name: EcSm2EncryptHint
data.value: SM2 uses sm2p256v1 and SM3. Ciphertext is Base64 C1C3C2 or C1C2C3 with an uncompressed C1 point.

data.name: InvalidCipherLength
data.value: The input length is invalid for this mode and padding.

data.name: UnsupportedAssociatedData
data.value: This mode does not support additional authenticated data.

data.name: EcPublicImportHint
data.value: Drop a public key or certificate, or enter PEM / Base64 / Hex key data.

data.name: EcPrivateImportHint
data.value: Drop an unencrypted PEM/DER private key, or paste its PEM text.

data.name: CoordinateEncodingHint
data.value: Unsigned big-endian coordinates in the selected encoding.

data.name: RsaPublicImportHint
data.value: Drop an RSA public key or certificate, or enter PEM / Base64 / Hex public key data.

data.name: RsaPrivateImportHint
data.value: Drop an unencrypted PKCS#8 / PKCS#1 RSA private key (PEM/DER), or paste PEM text.

data.name: CrcDescription
data.value: Calculate CRCs using standard presets or custom polynomials and parameters.

data.name: CrcPolynomialHint
data.value: Normal Hex representation, without the highest x^width term. An optional 0x prefix is accepted.

data.name: InvalidCrcParameters
data.value: Invalid CRC parameters. Width must be 1–64 and all values must fit the width; polynomial must be nonzero.

data.name: InvalidCrcHex
data.value: Enter a hexadecimal value within the selected width (optional 0x prefix).

data.name: CrcPresetDescription
data.value: Choose a CRC algorithm. Expand to edit its parameters.

data.name: CrcWidthDescription
data.value: Number of bits in the CRC result, from 1 to 64.

data.name: CrcInitialDescription
data.value: Hex value loaded into the CRC register before processing the input.

data.name: CrcXorOutDescription
data.value: Hex value XORed with the CRC after output reflection.

data.name: CrcReflectInputDescription
data.value: Process each input byte from its least significant bit.

data.name: CrcReflectOutputDescription
data.value: Reverse the CRC register bits before applying the final XOR.

data.name: CrcCheckDescription
data.value: Standard result for ASCII 123456789. Cleared when parameters are customized.
